subject: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sanchez <emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to put a short stage-gate mutual action plan (MAP) in writing so Clarity Health and Redwood have aligned success criteria for the 6-week pilot. Key asks from your side were: 1) a pilot credit commitment, 2) clear acceptance criteria so engineering can validate, and 3) commercial terms if you convert to paid service.

Draft MAP attached (ClarityHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx). Highlights:
- Week 0: access & onboarding (one dedicated SE session)
- Weeks 1–3: feature validation against 3 success metrics (latency p95 < 400ms, model accuracy on test set > 85%, inference cost < $0.015/token equivalent)
- Weeks 4–6: ramp tests and production throughput (sustained 200 reqs/min with KV caching)
- Acceptance signoff: product owner + engineering success criteria checklist in the attached template

Commercial proposal to enable this:
- Redwood provides $25k in pilot credits applied to token/compute usage.
- If Clarity signs a 6‑month committed-usage agreement within 30 days of acceptance, we will convert any unused pilot credits to a one-time onboarding credit and apply a 12% conversion discount off list for the first 3 months of the committed term.
- If Clarity commits to a reserved capacity tier (monthly commit), we’ll offer a further 5% volume rebate once monthly committed usage exceeds the threshold in the attached pricing sheet.

Next steps: please review MAP and attachments and confirm: (a) acceptance criteria are correct, (b) procurement needs for PO or PO waiver, and (c) whether you want the pilot start next Monday (Oct 6) or prefer a one-week delay.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to finalize.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0187

-----
From: Emma Sanchez <emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.r@clarityhealth.com>, Clarity Health Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Sofia —

Thanks for the write-up and the MAP. The milestones look good overall. A couple clarifications:
1) Can you confirm whether the $25k pilot credit covers model hosting + token consumption and any seat-based SE hours?
2) Procurement needs SOC2 evidence and a short statement on data residency for PHI-adjacent PII before legal will approve any PO.
3) Can we get the acceptance checklist as a Google Sheet so our engineering manager can comment inline?

We’d prefer start on Oct 13 to ensure our infra team can allocate time.

—Emma
Emma Sanchez
Director, Product Innovation | Clarity Health
emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Sofia — quick notes to address Emma’s technical questions:
- $25k pilot credit covers all usage on the hosted API (generation + embeddings) and up to 8 hours of SE onboarding support. Additional SE hours billed T&M unless we convert and apply onboarding credit.
- SOC2 snapshot attached (SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf) — it’s a redacted readout we can share with procurement.
- I’ll convert the acceptance checklist to Google Sheets and share a comment link.

Also calling out the acceptance metrics: we might want to relax inference cost target to $0.018/token-equivalent for the pilot to account for smaller batch sizes during testing. Will confirm after first week of profiling.

—Ben

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Team —
Drafting the commercial language I promised. Two points to confirm with the customer before we lock into the DocuSign:
1) Conversion discount mechanics: 12% off list for first 3 months after conversion is contingent on (a) executed 6-month committed spend agreement and (b) acceptance signoff within the MAP window.
2) Unused pilot credits: we can convert them to a one-time onboarding credit up to the $25k cap but cannot refund. We should specify whether onboarding credits expire within 90 days of conversion; proposing 90 days.

If procurement needs a PO before Oct 13 start, we can accept a soft PO (purchase order) and start onboarding while legal finishes the contract redlines.

I’ll create the DocuSign draft and link it in the thread.

—Karthik

-----
From: Emma Sanchez <emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Clarity Health Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.r@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Sofia / Karthik —

All sounds reasonable. Procurement will request a short addendum confirming data residency (we host logs in us‑west by default; can we confirm retention policy for traces/kv cache) and confirm that onboarding credits are non-refundable but transferable to account-level services. I’ll ask legal to review the DocuSign draft once Karthik posts it.

We are okay with Oct 13 start date. Please share the Google Sheet for acceptance checklist.

—Emma

-----
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sanchez <emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Emma —

Thanks — attaching the Google Sheet link and the DocuSign draft. Quick updates:
- Ben confirmed the pilot credit scope and SOC2 snapshot attached.
- Karthik posted the DocuSign preview: https://documentcloud.example/docusign/rw-clarity-draft
- On data residency: logs and KV cache retention default to us-west region; retention for traces is 30 days by default (can be extended via paid retention add-on). I’ve added that language to the addendum draft.

I will schedule the kickoff for Oct 13 at 09:30 PT. Agenda: onboarding + SE session, ingest checklist, initial profiling run.

Once legal signs the DocuSign (soft signature) we’ll provision tenant credentials and seed the pilot credits.

—Sofia

-----
From: Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Sanchez <emma.sanchez@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP: pilot milestones, credit allocation, and conversion terms

Sofia / Karthik —

We reviewed the DocuSign draft and the SOC2 snapshot. A few procurement comments before we issue PO:
- Please add a clause noting logs containing PHI-adjacent metadata will be redacted at rest and access limited to named contacts.
- Confirm onboarding credit conversion terms and expiration (we accept the 90-day onboarding credit expiry).
- Confirm Redwood’s standard invoice net terms (we prefer Net 60 for pilot invoicing).

If you can update the draft by EOD Thursday we will route the PO and sign the soft DocuSign.

—Clarity Health Procurement

[Attachments referenced: ClarityHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf, pilot-usage-template.csv]
